name: Niki7a
biography: There is truly only one sorceress that ensures the machinations of Def Con continue to move. She is both in tune with the magic and digital functions and is the power behind the CFP board from start to finish as well as the coordination of so many other activities behind the curtain. She works tirelessly year-round to make sure everything runs smoothly. Also, she is fun at parties and awesome AF. @niki7a
